ResearchProjectDef.label: annelitrice fountain
ResearchProjectDef.description: The production bench for annelitrice recipes, including transmog apparel, egg-related items, nutrient solution.

ResearchProjectDef.label: annelitrice nutrient solution
ResearchProjectDef.description: The suspicious liquid contained in a bottle is both more potent and repulsive than nutrient paste meals, and its unpleasant taste cannot be disguised by artificial flavorings. Surprisingly, annelitrice have no aversion to it since they are raised in its presence.

ResearchProjectDef.label: annelitrice puppet theatre
ResearchProjectDef.description: Societies without electricity still need television, so they invented puppetry. With a few wooden dolls and suspiciously elaborate costumes, colonists can reenact famous works whose creators have long since been forgotten. So historic accuracy is optional.
